fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Selective Authentication
fields.help: Whether the trusted side has forest/domain wide access or selective access to an approved set of resources.

fields.label: Target DNS IP Addresses
fields.help: The target DNS server IP addresses which can resolve the remote domain involved in the trust.

fields.label: Target Domain Name
fields.help: The fully qualified target domain name which will be in trust with the current domain.

fields.label: Trust Direction
fields.help: The trust direction, which decides if the current domain is trusted, trusting, or both.

fields.label: Trust Handshake Secret
fields.help: The trust secret used for the handshake with the target domain.

fields.label: Trust Type
fields.help: The type of trust represented by the trust resource.
